transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because lately, after a long shift or when I’m done studying, I end up eating way more than I mean to. Like I’ll have a whole fast-food meal, then snacks and whatever else is in the fridge, all in one sitting.
When this happens, do you feel unable to stop eating or control how much you’re eating?
Yeah. Once I start, it’s like I can’t make myself stop. I’m telling myself to quit, and I’m already feeling sick, but I just keep grabbing more food.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit to try to undo them?
Sometimes, yeah. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. Other times I take laxatives because I’m scared of what all that food is going to do to me.
During those eating episodes, do you feel like you lose control over your eating?
Yeah. Once I start, it feels like I can’t control it. I’m telling myself to stop, even when I’m already feeling sick, but I just keep reaching for more food.
Is your body weight or shape something that has a big effect on how you feel about yourself?
Yeah, it does. If I look in the mirror before work and my stomach or chest looks soft, I feel like I’m sloppy at everything—not just how I look.
Are you currently at a very low body weight for your height?
I’m not really sure what counts as very low for my height. I haven’t been told that I am.
